policyDecisions.rule: Keys do not sync unless explicitly re-approved.
ReceiveDrawHUD remains disabled because of crash history.
Player health must use CrabPC -> PlayerState -> CrabPS -> HealthInfo.
Every unsafe write/apply and forbidden carrier entry documented in the two policy ledgers is a first-class terminal catalog row.
Raw platform/name/identity values remain disabled; bounded fingerprints may be used only for session correlation.
RuntimeProbe never writes properties; official natural paths are investigated first.
Presence or natural observation does not authorize calls or prove write/apply safety.
Legacy write suggestions are concern provenance only and can never advance a safety status.
